description: This file declares utility functions and enums related to metrics collection and reporting within the 'metrics' namespace for the Cuttlefish project. It includes function declarations for obtaining system information, generating session IDs, converting protobuf log events to strings, and posting requests to a server.

methods.name: GetOsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operating system.

methods.name: GetOsVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the operating system.

methods.name: GenerateSessionId
methods.description: Generates a unique session ID based on the current timestamp.

methods.name: GetMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the host machine.

methods.name: GetCompany
methods.description: Returns the name of the company.

methods.name: GetVmmVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the Virtual Machine Monitor.

methods.name: GetEpochTimeMs
methods.description: Returns the current epoch time in milliseconds.

methods.name: ProtoToString
methods.description: Converts a LogEvent protobuf message to its string representation.

methods.name: PostRequest
methods.description: Posts a metrics report to the specified server.
